issues.name: Public Safety
issues.hook: The Council has repeatedly taken up crime legislation, including the Secure DC omnibus and juvenile curfew authority.
sources: DC Council votes to pass Secure DC crime bill (The Eagle)

issues.name: Budget
issues.hook: The Council votes on the Mayor’s annual budget each summer; the fiscal 2026 budget was voted on in July 2025.
sources: D.C. Council will conduct its first vote on the fiscal 2026 budget on July 14 (Washington Informer)
